hooks.command: S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-.}}/scripts/unarmored_hook.py"; set -f; IFS=:; for D in $PATH; do case "$D" in *WindowsApps*|*windowsapps*) continue;; esac; for B in python3 python python.exe; do if [ -x "$D/$B" ] && [ -s "$D/$B" ]; then unset IFS; exec "$D/$B" -E -S "$S"; fi; done; done; unset IFS; exec python3 -E -S "$S"
